applicableAreas: entire site - construction occurs near existing transmission facilities
findings.comment: Sheet 3 Electric Transmission Notes explicitly require: 'A pre-construction safety meeting is required with Austin Energy 48 hours before commencement of construction. Call Andrew Perez at 512-505-7153 to schedule a tailgate safety meeting.' Site has existing transmission facilities (poles and overhead lines) on southern and southwestern boundaries with electric easements on property. No documentation provided showing this required pre-construction meeting has been scheduled or will occur 48 hours before construction begins.

applicableAreas: southern property boundary - grading and retaining wall construction
findings.comment: Sheet 3 Electric Transmission Notes require: 'Grading near electric transmission facilities must be coordinated with Austin Energy prior to commencement of grading. Call Andrew Perez at 512-505-7153 to schedule a meeting.' and 'Do not dig or grade within 25 feet of the transmission structures, including down guy anchors.' Grading Plan (Sheet 11) shows significant fill work (4-10 foot vertical changes) and retaining wall construction immediately adjacent to southern property boundary where transmission structures and electric easements are located. Existing Survey (Sheet 4) confirms power poles with guy wires are present on the southern boundary. No documentation of Austin Energy coordination, approval, or excavation evaluation is provided in the site plan or supplementary documents.

Sheet 3 Electric Transmission Notes state: 'No trees shall be planted within the transmission easement. No trees shall be planted within 25 feet of the base of the transmission structure.' Landscape Plan (Sheet 31) shows multiple large trees (Mitigation Trees designated 'M' and Parking Buffer Point Trees designated 'P') proposed directly overlapping or immediately adjacent to the OHE (Overhead Electric) line at the southern property boundary where transmission structures and easements are located. These trees are planted within the transmission easement and/or within 25 feet of transmission structure base, violating the prohibition. Additionally, no verification is provided that these trees are utility-compatible species marked 'UC' in ECM Appendix F with mature heights ≤20 feet as required by the transmission facility restrictions.
